title: 介词、连词与感叹词
subtitle: 关系、连接与情感的语言编码——从 at/on/in 到 FANBOYS 与从属连词

intro.title: 介词：认知地图，不是死记硬背
intro.body:
介词让中国学生头疼，是因为很多人把介词当孤立搭配死背。其实介词有规律：**所有抽象用法都源于基本的空间含义**。

**空间 → 时间 → 抽象（依次扩展）：**

- **in**（在里面）：in the room（空间）→ in 2024（时间段）→ in trouble/in love（抽象状态）
- **on**（在表面接触）：on the table（空间）→ on Monday（特定日期）→ on sale/on duty（运作状态）
- **at**（在某个点）：at the door（空间点）→ at noon（时刻点）→ at risk/at war（状态节点）

理解这个规律，就能从「理解」而非「背诵」出发，举一反三。

intro.title: 时间介词：at/on/in 三层结构
intro.body:
时间介词是使用频率最高、最容易出错的类别：

**AT（点）→ 精确时刻：**
- at 6 o'clock / at noon / at midnight / at dawn
- at the weekend（英式）/ at Christmas
- at night（晚上，不是 in the night）
- at the age of 6（在6岁时）

**ON（面）→ 具体日期/特定某天：**
- on Monday / on weekdays / on weekends（美式）
- on March 15th / on my birthday / on New Year's Day
- on time（准时，按计划）vs. in time（及时，来得及）

**IN（段）→ 较长时间段：**
- in the morning / in January / in summer / in 2024
- in the 21st century
- in time（及时）vs. on time（准时）
- in the end（最终）vs. at the end（在结尾处）
intro.tip: on time vs. in time：on time = 准点，按时间表；in time = 及时，没有错过。"The train arrived on time."（火车准点到）vs. "I arrived just in time."（我刚好赶上了）

intro.title: 易混淆时间介词：by/until、since/for、in/within
intro.body:
**by vs. until（till）：**
- **by**（截止，强调「不迟于某时」，一次性动作）
  - Please finish this **by** Friday.（周五前完成）
  - She will be back **by** 6 pm.
- **until/till**（持续直到某时间点）
  - I waited **until** midnight.（我等到午夜）
  - Don't leave **until** I come back.
- 对比：I'll work **by** Friday.（周五前完成——结果）vs. I'll work **until** Friday.（工作到周五——过程）

**since vs. for：**
- **since** + 时间点（从某个时间点开始，用完成时）
  - She has lived here **since** 2010.
- **for** + 时间段（持续了多长时间）
  - She has lived here **for** ten years.

**in vs. within：**
- **in** ten minutes = 从现在起10分钟后
- **within** 24 hours = 在24小时之内（强调不超过）
intro.tip: since 后接时间点（since 2010 / since Monday）；for 后接时间段（for ten years / for three days）。这是完成时考题的核心考点！

intro.title: 地点介词：above/over、below/under、between/among
intro.body:
**above vs. over（上方）：**
- **above**：高于某物，不一定正上方，不涉及覆盖
  - The plane flew **above** the clouds.（飞机在云层上方飞行）
  - Her score is **above** average.（成绩在平均分以上）
- **over**：直接在正上方，或「覆盖」，或「越过」，或「超过」
  - There's a lamp **over** the table.（灯在桌子正上方）
  - She spread a blanket **over** the bed.（盖上毯子）
  - **over** 100 people = more than 100 people

**below vs. under（下方）：**
- **below**：低于某物（不一定正下方），抽象场景多
  - The temperature fell **below** freezing.
- **under**：直接在正下方，或覆盖之下，抽象含义丰富
  - The cat is **under** the table.
  - **under** pressure / **under** control / **under** construction

**between vs. among：**
- **between**：两个独立个体之间（也可用于三个明确个体之间）
  - She sat **between** Tom and Mary.
- **among**：三者或多者组成的群体内部
  - She is the most talented **among** her classmates.

**beside vs. besides：**
- **beside**（介词）：在...旁边（空间）
- **besides**（介词/副词）：除了...之外（还）
  - **Besides** English, she speaks French.（除了英语，她还会法语）

intro.title: 并列连词 FANBOYS——连接对等成分
intro.body:
英语并列连词共 7 个，用首字母组成 **FANBOYS**：

| 连词 | 含义 | 例句 |
|------|------|------|
| **F**or | 因为（正式） | He must be tired, **for** he's worked all day. |
| **A**nd | 和，然后 | She is intelligent **and** hardworking. |
| **N**or | 也不 | She doesn't smoke, **nor** does she drink. |
| **B**ut | 但是 | It was expensive **but** worth it. |
| **O**r | 或者，否则 | Hurry up, **or** you'll miss the train. |
| **Y**et | 然而（语气强） | She is young, **yet** very mature. |
| **S**o | 所以 | It was raining, **so** we stayed inside. |

**标点规则：**
- 连接两个独立句子：**逗号 + 连词**
  - ✅ She was tired, **but** she kept working.
  - ❌ She was tired, she kept working.（逗号拼接错误 Comma Splice，严重语法错误！）
- 连接单词/短语：不加逗号（tea and coffee）
intro.tip: nor 后面要倒装！"She doesn't smoke, nor does she drink."（不能说 nor she drinks）

intro.title: 从属连词——时间、原因、条件、让步
intro.body:
从属连词引导的从句依附于主句，语义关系丰富：

**时间连词（when/while/as/until/as soon as）：**
- **while**（同时进行两个动作）：While he was cooking, she was reading.
- **until**（直到...才）：Wait here **until** I return.
- **as soon as**（一...就...）：**As soon as** she heard the news, she called.

**原因连词（because/since/as）：**
- **because**（最直接，可放句首或句中）：She was late **because** her car broke down.
- **since/as**（原因已知，语气弱，通常句首）：**Since** you're here, you might as well help.

**条件连词（if/unless/as long as/in case）：**
- **unless** = if...not：**Unless** you hurry, you'll be late.
- **as long as**（只要）：**As long as** you try your best, I'll be proud.
- **in case**（以防，预防性）：Take an umbrella **in case** it rains.（不是 if it rains）

**让步连词（although/though/even though/even if）：**
- **even though** > **although** > **though**（语气由强到弱）
- **even if**（即使，假设性）：**Even if** I fail, I won't give up.
- ❌ Despite he was tired... → ✅ Although he was tired...（despite/in spite of 后接名词，不接从句！）
intro.tip: in case ≠ if！in case 强调「提前预防」：Take an umbrella in case it rains.（带伞以防下雨）。if 表示条件：Take an umbrella if it rains.（下雨的话带伞）。两者时态和含义都不同。

intro.title: 关联连词——成对出现，要求平行结构
intro.body:
关联连词成对使用，**连接的两部分必须结构平行**（都是名词、都是形容词、都是句子等）。

**both...and（两者都）：**
- She is both **intelligent** and **hardworking**.（两个形容词，平行）
- ❌ She is both intelligent and **works hard**.（形容词 vs. 动词短语，不平行）

**either...or（要么...要么，两选一）：**
- Either you come with me, or you stay here.
- 动词就近一致：**Either** he or his brothers **are** responsible.（brothers 靠近动词）

**neither...nor（既不...也不）：**
- She speaks **neither** French **nor** German.

**not only...but also（不仅...而且）：**
- She is **not only** talented **but also** dedicated.
- ⚠️ Not only 位于句首时，**主句须倒装**：
  - ✅ **Not only did** he apologize, but he also offered to help.
  - ❌ Not only he apologized, but he also helped.

**目的结果连词：**
- **so...that**（如此...以至于）：He was **so** tired **that** he fell asleep.
- **such...that**（如此...以至于，接名词短语）：It was **such** a good film **that** we watched it twice.

reveal.q: "Despite she was tired, she kept smiling." 这句话对吗？如何改正？
reveal.a: 错误。despite 和 in spite of 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不能接从句（that/she/he 等）。改法：①Although she was tired, she kept smiling.（用从属连词 although）；②Despite her tiredness, she kept smiling.（用名词）；③In spite of being tired, she kept smiling.（用动名词）

intro.title: 感叹词与话语标记——地道英语的润滑剂
intro.body:
**感叹词（Interjections）——表达情感，独立使用：**
- 惊讶：Oh! / Wow! / Gosh! / Good heavens!
- 高兴：Great! / Fantastic! / Yay! / Hooray!
- 痛苦：Ouch! / Ow!（疼痛）/ Oh no!（失望）
- 犹豫：Um... / Uh... / Hmm... / Er...

**话语标记（Discourse Markers）——组织对话，表达态度：**

| 功能 | 常用词 |
|------|--------|
| 顺序 | First / Then / Finally |
| 增加信息 | Also / Furthermore / Moreover / In addition |
| 转折 | However / Nevertheless / On the other hand |
| 举例 | For example / For instance / Such as |
| 总结 | In conclusion / To sum up / In short |
| 诚实表态 | Honestly / Frankly / To be honest |
| 显然 | Obviously / Clearly / Apparently |
| 软化语气 | I think / I believe / It seems / Perhaps |

⚠️ 口语中过度使用 "like"、"you know" 是不成熟的标志，正式表达中要尽量避免。

intro.title: 词性转换规律——掌握词根，词汇翻倍
intro.body:
英语通过前缀和后缀进行词性转换，掌握规律可以大幅扩展词汇量。

**动词 → 名词：**
- -tion/-sion：create → **creation**, decide → **decision**
- -ment：develop → **development**, achieve → **achievement**
- -ance/-ence：perform → **performance**, prefer → **preference**
- -er/-or：teach → **teacher**, act → **actor**

**名词/动词 → 形容词：**
- -ful/-less：hope → **hopeful / hopeless**
- -ous/-ious：danger → **dangerous**, glory → **glorious**
- -able/-ible：read → **readable**, sense → **sensible**
- -ing（主动）/ -ed（被动）：interest → **interesting** book / **interested** student

**形容词 → 副词（通常 + -ly）：**
- quick → **quickly**, happy → **happily**, dramatic → **dramatically**

**词族示例：**
- educate(V) → education(N) → educational(Adj) → educationally(Adv) → educator(N)
- create(V) → creation(N) → creative(Adj) → creatively(Adv) → creativity(N)

questions.prompt: "She has been working here ___ 2019."（从2019年起）和 "She has been working here ___ five years."（持续了五年）正确填入：
questions.explain: since 后接时间点（since 2019），for 后接时间段（for five years）。这是完成时的核心搭配。

questions.prompt: "Please finish this report until Friday."（意在表达：周五之前完成）这句话是正确的。
questions.explain: by 表示「截止，不迟于某时」（一次性动作结束）；until 表示「持续直到」。这里应该用 by：Please finish this report by Friday.（周五前完成这份报告）

questions.prompt: "She is talented ___ also very dedicated."（不仅...而且...，not only 在句首时）
questions.explain: Not only 位于句首时，后面的从句须倒装（助动词提前）。She is talented → Not only is she talented, but also very dedicated. 注意是 is she，不是 she is。

questions.prompt: 将左边的情况与右边应该用 above 还是 over 配对：
left: 她的成绩在平均分以上
questions.explain: above 表示「高于某物」，用于抽象比较（above average）或飞机飞在云层上方（不直接接触）；over 表示「正上方」（a lamp over the table）、「覆盖」（spread a blanket over）或「超过数量」（over 100 people）。

questions.prompt: "Despite he was tired, he kept working." 语法正确。
questions.explain: despite 和 in spite of 是介词，后面只能接名词或动名词，不能接句子（不能接 he/she/that 等引导的从句）。正确改法：Although he was tired, he kept working.（用连词）或 Despite his tiredness, he kept working.（用名词）

questions.prompt: 填入正确的介词："Take an umbrella ___ it rains."（提前预防，不是条件）
questions.explain: in case 表示「以防」，强调提前预防。if 表示「如果」，是条件关系。Take an umbrella in case it rains（带伞以防万一下雨）表达的是预防，而非等下雨了才带伞。

questions.prompt: "She is both intelligent ___ works very hard." 这句话：
options: 正确，and 后面可以跟动词短语
错误，both...and 要求平行结构，应改为 both intelligent and hardworking
错误，应该用 not only...but also
questions.explain: both...and 要求严格的平行结构：both A and B 中，A 和 B 必须是相同的语法成分。intelligent 是形容词，works very hard 是动词短语，不平行。正确：She is both intelligent and hardworking.（两个形容词）

questions.prompt: "___ you and me, this plan won't work."（私下里，between 还是 among？）
questions.explain: between 用于两个独立个体之间（you and me = 两个人）；among 用于三者或多者组成的群体内部。"between you and me" 是固定短语，意为「私下里，我们之间」。

questions.prompt: 并列连词连接两个完整句子时，可以只用逗号而不用连词，如："She was tired, she kept working."
questions.explain: 这是「逗号拼接错误」（Comma Splice），是英语写作中的严重语法错误。两个独立句子必须用并列连词连接（逗号 + but/and/so 等）：She was tired, but she kept working. 或用分号：She was tired; she kept working.
